title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Kompleksi Aura ne Rr. Dritan Hoxha
description_sq: Ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha, ne kompleks i cili ndodhet ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit me akses ne rrugen kryesore, shesim nje apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 131 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 8 te banimit, dhe ka nje organizim me 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 sallon pritje, 2 tualete dhe ballkon. Kompleksi eshte ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit dhe per pak muaj dorezohet. Ky apartament ka nje organizim shume te mire, kuadratik dhe eshte i mire ndricuar.
title_en: 2+1 Apartment for sale in the Aura Complex in St. Dritan Hoxha
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha Street, in the complex which is in the last phase of construction with access to the main road, we sell a 2+1 apartment with a surface area of ​​131 m2. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of the residence, and has an arrangement with 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 2 toilets and a balcony. The complex is in the final stage of construction and will be delivered in a few months. This apartment has a very good organization, square and is well lit.
